title: Git-blob newline domain with clean named-lane replay
failure_signature: Exact staging emitted future LF-to-CRLF working-copy conversion warnings for new text files.
candidate_workaround: Use normalized staged Git blobs for hashes, inspect CRLF and LF counts and diff hygiene explicitly, then require one LF-preserving clean named-lane replay at the exact final head.
recurrence_guard: Never claim cross-checkout byte parity from a warning-bearing working tree alone; bind manifests to Git blobs and retain the warning until the exact named replay passes.
rollback: Stop before commit if staged blobs, content seals, or diff hygiene disagree; retain the warning and repair only phase-owned files without changing repository-wide configuration.
scope_boundary: Newline and manifest portability only; the later same-owner named replay is not independent reproduction.
